mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_token (account_id, purpose, token_digest, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{purpose}, #{tokenDigest}, #{expiresAt}, #{consumedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, purpose, token_digest, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM auth_token WHERE token_digest = #{tokenDigest}
